threatLevel: Overall OT Cyber Threat Level: CRITICAL
executiveSummary: Threat level remains critical due to active exploitation of PLCs in water and wastewater operations, causing operator lockouts and service impacts. Security Advisory Multiple VPN/edge management products are under active attack (Check Point Remote/Mobile Access IKEv1 auth-bypass; N-able N-central RMM auth-bypass; F5 BIG-IP APM RCE), enabling direct perimeter compromise and lateral movement. Security Advisory KEV Notice OT-native risks are elevated by a protocol-level integrity flaw in Mitsubishi Electric CC-Link IE TSN (no patch), and engineering-workstation code execution in Schneider IGSS-both threatening loss of control if abused. ICS Advisory ICS Advisory Nation-state operations targeting critical services continue: China-nexus covert networks of compromised SOHO/IoT devices for pre-positioning; Iranian-affiliated actors manipulating PLC logic/alarm states; APT activity against aviation/telecom/government with covert WSS tunneling. Joint Advisory Joint Advisory Ransomware and supply-chain exposure remain acute via exploited VPNs/RMMs, compromised email platforms, and EV charging/telecom infrastructure vulnerabilities-presenting operational disruption risks across energy, manufacturing, and communications. View Article CISA Bulletin Key defensive imperatives: patch and harden perimeter devices; rotate credentials/keys; eliminate direct OT/PLC internet exposure; enforce MFA and strict segmentation; and conduct targeted threat hunting on VPN/RMM, firewall managers, and HMI/PLC assets.

events.title: WWS PLCs targeted for lockouts and configuration abuse
events.text: Operators reported forced manual operations and boil-water notices due to password and IP changes on internet-exposed PLCs. Remove internet exposure, broker via MFA-enabled gateways, and restore from clean backups.

events.title: Check Point VPN auth-bypass (CVE-2026-50751) actively exploited
events.text: IKEv1-enabled deployments allow unauthorized VPN access. Disable IKEv1 immediately, apply vendor fixes, rotate creds/tokens, and review VPN/AD logs for anomalous access.

events.title: F5 BIG-IP APM unauth RCE under active exploitation (CVE-2025-53521)
events.text: Attackers execute commands via iControl REST "util bash," deploy persistence, and attempt SELinux disablement. Restrict/monitor REST, hunt IOCs, reimage if compromised, and rotate credentials/certs.

events.title: INC ransomware exploiting SonicWall SMA 1000 zero-days
events.text: Active intrusions leverage KNUCKLEBALL and web shells to steal creds, sessions, and TOTP seeds. Patch, invalidate sessions, rotate secrets, and threat-hunt /wsproxy access and lateral movement.

events.title: Iranian-affiliated actors exploiting PLCs across US critical infrastructure
events.text: Manipulation of project files/AOIs and HMI data to disable alarms and safety logic. Remove internet access, enforce zones/conduits, place controllers in RUN, and validate logic integrity.

events.title: China-nexus covert networks of compromised devices pre-positioning against CNI
events.text: Actors route operations through large fleets of compromised routers/IoT to evade attribution. Enforce router hygiene (SNMPv3, disable SMI), segmentation, and egress controls.

events.title: N-able N-central RMM auth-bypass (CVE-2026-18577) - active exploitation
events.text: Admin takeover enables mass endpoint control and lateral movement. Patch (2026.3 HF1/3.1), restrict exposure, audit "Take Control," and hunt for cloudflared tunnels/rogue svchost.exe.

events.title: Cisco Secure FMC hard-coded password exploited (KEV)
events.text: Compromise risks collapse of segmentation and unauthorized rule changes. Patch, rotate secrets, validate policies, and review admin accounts/sessions.

events.title: Ivanti EPMM RCEs (CVE-2026-1281/1340) exploited with public PoC
events.text: Attacks via crafted GETs to /mifs/… with JSP webshell persistence; isolate appliances, patch, hunt, and assess SSO/IdP integration risk.

events.title: Pro-Russia hacktivists abusing exposed VNC-connected HMIs/SCADA
events.text: Observed loss of view, parameter changes, downtime, and some physical damage. Remove exposure, enforce strong auth and segmentation, and monitor setpoint/alarm changes.

events.title: GeoServer RCE (CVE-2024-36401) leveraged against US agency
events.text: China Chopper webshells and Stowaway C2 used to pivot to SQL server; immediate patching and hunting for listed ports/processes advised.

events.title: Telecom femtocell certificate abuse and BPFDoor on internal servers (KT)
events.text: Rogue femtocell enabled ARS/SMS interception and fraud; regulators found BPFDoor on 38 servers. Revoke/rotate device certs, segment management, and hunt eBPF backdoors.

events.title: Midnight Blizzard via captive portals targeting traveler identities
events.text: Hijacked captive portals deliver fake updates/device-code phishing to deploy CornFlake RAT/ChocoShell; enforce conditional access and avoid captive-portal software prompts.

events.title: CISA weekly CVE rollups with OT relevance (PcVue, IoTDB, BeyondTrust)
events.text: HMI credential/storage weaknesses, time-series DB path traversal, and remote support pre-auth bypass-patch per vendor notes and restrict exposure.

events.title: EV charging infrastructure RCEs and unsigned firmware paths
events.text: Multiple pre-auth command injection vectors and weak update mechanisms risk charger takeover and service disruption; segment, require mTLS, and patch.

events.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday: ADFS/SharePoint exploited; BitLocker bypass
events.text: Record volume patches include exploited zero-days affecting identity and SharePoint ingress; expedite patching and identity hardening.

events.title: Mirage Kitten: new backdoors and WSS tunnelers against aviation/telecom
events.text: NightLedger/BridgeHead/ArcBridge enable covert C2 and per-target execution; harden DLL search paths, enforce WDAC/AppLocker, and monitor egress to suspicious WSS endpoints.

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit public-facing applications and VPNs (ATT&CK T1190, T1133); auth bypass on VPN/RMM; webshells on appliances.
Persistence: Application passcodes in email platforms; scheduled tasks, WMI subscriptions; rogue services; device tunnels.
Credential Access: Token theft (M365), password dumps, AD federation abuse; interception via compromised gateways.
Command and Control: Covert WSS/HTTPS tunnels; residential/SOHO proxy infrastructure; DNS-based exfil.
Lateral Movement: RDP/SSH, PsExec/PAExec; abuse of remote admin modules in RMM and EVSE backends.
ICS ATT&CK: Loss of View/Control via exposed VNC HMIs (TA0103); Modify Controller Tasking (T0858); Inhibit Response Function (T0814); Protocol abuse (Modbus/IEC 61850).

outlook72h: Expect continued exploitation attempts against VPNs/RMM/firewall managers; prioritize emergency patching, exposure reduction, and token/credential rotation on these devices. Increase monitoring of OT gateways and HMIs for unauthorized configuration changes, alarm suppression, and logic downloads-validate backups and readiness to restore. Activate targeted hunts for N-able "Take Control" misuse, F5 iControl REST "util bash" artifacts, Check Point IKEv1-based access, and SonicWall SMA /wsproxy access trails. For CC-Link IE TSN environments, enforce strict segmentation and device access controls now; prepare containment playbooks for suspected IO tampering.
